name: The New York Times editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates New York Times (Opinion) Left (small group editorial review Feb. 2025; high confidence as of Oct. 2026). The board stopped endorsing in New York races in August 2024.

name: New York Daily News editorial board
lean_basis: Ad Fontes rates the New York Daily News Skews Left (-8.10). The board still endorses in New York races (it endorsed in the 2025 mayoral race).

name: New York Post editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates New York Post (Opinion) Right (split out July 2020; low or initial confidence as of Oct. 2026) and its news Right (June 2026 editorial review).

name: Newsday editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates Newsday Center (independent review, low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). No separate editorial-board rating was found.

name: Times Union (Albany) editorial board
lean_basis: No usable rating: AllSides rates a 'Times Union' Center but does not say whether it is Albany's or Jacksonville's, and no Ad Fontes rating was found. The Hearst daily's site states no ideological mission, so it is shown as not rated.

name: League of Women Voters of New York State (VOTE411)
lean_basis: League of Women Voters state chapter that calls the League 'a strictly nonpartisan citizen activist organization' (https://www.lwvny.org/about). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: New York State Democratic Committee
lean_basis: Official state party. Its nominees appear on the Democratic line of the certified ballot.

name: New York Republican State Committee
lean_basis: Official state party. Its nominees appear on the Republican line of the certified ballot.

name: Working Families Party (New York)
lean_basis: Official party organization with its own New York ballot line; a WFP endorsement puts the candidate on the Working Families line.

name: Conservative Party of New York State
lean_basis: Official party organization (the Conservative Party of New York State) with its own ballot line; its endorsement puts the candidate on the Conservative line.

name: New York State AFL-CIO
lean_basis: Self-described progressive labor federation: 'the New York State AFL-CIO is a force for progressive change' (https://nysaflcio.org/about-us). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: NYSUT (New York State United Teachers)
lean_basis: State teachers' union that describes itself as 'a federation of more than 1,200 local unions' (https://www.nysut.org/about). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Police Benevolent Association of New York State
lean_basis: Police union whose stated aim is 'To protect and preserve our police officers’ rights and freedoms and improve their working conditions' (https://www.pbanys.org/pba/about/), with no ideological language. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: NYSCOPBA (New York State Correctional Officers and Police Benevolent Association)
lean_basis: Correction officers' union whose stated objectives are 'to improve the terms and conditions of employment, protect our members contractual rights' (https://www.nyscopba.org/about), with no ideological language. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Planned Parenthood Empire State Votes
lean_basis: Abortion-rights political arm of Planned Parenthood in New York. Planned Parenthood Action Fund says the federation works to 'defend reproductive rights' (https://www.plannedparenthoodaction.org/about-us). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.
